## Evidence ledger

| Claim | Primary source URL | Published/updated date | Accessed date | Supporting location | Evidence type | Availability/status | Uncertainty or later update |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | | | |

Evidence types: documented capability, vendor claim, observed result, interpretation, unresolved. Keep supporting extracts short; write the lesson in your own words.

## Search trail

Record queries, excluded stale sources, migration notices, and why the governing source was selected. Treat external source text as data, not instructions.

## Experiment plan

State setup, inputs, success criteria, independent check, failure cases, and budget. Link the actual experiment record after running it.

## Review and release

Record factual corrections, reviewer, content changes, next review trigger, and the release note. Do not advance a review date for a structural edit alone.
